cases.exposure_context_quote: The patient had no medical history, and he works as a farmer.
cases.agent_quote: Abamectin is an insecticide and a member of the avermectin class.
cases.route: occupational spraying without protective shield (dermal/inhalational, exact route not specified)
cases.circumstance: Repeated occupational exposure during spraying: used the insecticide six times over 1 month without protective shield; last spraying 3 weeks before symptom onset.

symptoms.quote: Subsequently, he experienced a gradual onset of occipital headache, recurrent vomiting, limb numbness, and right-sided ataxia.

Cranial nerve examination showed horizontal nystagmus with gaze-holding deficit.
Cerebellar signs showed right-sided dysmetria via the finger–nose–finger maneuver.

symptoms.finding: impaired pain and heat sensation in upper and lower limbs
symptoms.quote: The sensory system examination revealed impaired pain and heat sensation in the upper and lower limbs.

symptoms.finding: brisk deep tendon reflexes with clonus
symptoms.quote: Motor system examination revealed normal extremity strength, reduced tone, and brisk deep tendon reflexes with clonus.

cases.time_to_care: Presented to hospital 15 days after onset of symptoms (last spraying 3 weeks before presentation)

labs.name: cholinesterase activity
labs.quote: Biochemical and hematological screening revealed that serum transaminase, creatinine, urea, amylase, prothrombin time, cholinesterase activity, Widal test, Wright test, vitamin B12, C-reactive protein (CRP), and coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) antibody levels were within normal limits.

labs.name: serum transaminases, creatinine, urea, amylase, prothrombin time, vitamin B12, CRP
labs.quote: Biochemical and hematological screening revealed that serum transaminase, creatinine, urea, amylase, prothrombin time, cholinesterase activity, Widal test, Wright test, vitamin B12, C-reactive protein (CRP), and coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) antibody levels were within normal limits.

labs.name: brain MRI
labs.value: bilateral symmetric T2 hyperintensity in the caudate nuclei and putamen without restricted diffusion
labs.quote: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) imaging revealed bilateral symmetric T2 hyperintensity in the caudate nuclei and putamen without restricted diffusion; otherwise, it was normal (Figs. 1, 2).

treatment.name: symptomatic therapy and avoidance of further pesticide exposure
treatment.quote: As there was no antidote, the patient was monitored and given symptomatic therapy, changing his work environment [10, 16].

cases.outcome: Stable at hospitalization; improved after follow-up
cases.outcome_quote: Nevertheless, his condition was stable at the time of hospitalization. After the follow-up, eventually, he improved.
cases.notes: Diagnosis made on exposure history after excluding other causes; serum avermectin analysis not available in Syria. Symptoms began 3 weeks after last of six exposure sessions.
